description: Adds a short contents list of a chapter's own subsections at the start of each chapter, alongside the document-level contents list. Applies to books only; an article is unaffected. Add :per-chapter-toc: to the document header to switch it on, and [per-chapter-toc=false] above a chapter to leave that one out. Styled by the same toc.* theme keys as the document-level list.
sampleContent: Each chapter opens with a list of its own subsections and their page numbers, in addition to the contents list at the front of the book.
